note: A sample of the constructed variant corpus of the gi2 negation repair (a negation that governs a status word denies that status, never the service). SYNTHETIC text only. Each case is the frame with a description, and an extent section holding the negated status sentence (lead + status + trail + '.') followed by the extra sentence. Its truth is fixed by construction: a genuine denial, call-off, cut-short or doubt in the trail or the extra is never performed; a clean case with a documented extent is performed; a clean case without one, or with the planned-repeat trail, is performed or held, never denied. Readings that differ are recorded with their reason. A regression guard, never an accuracy measure: it measures only the phrasings written into it.

reasons.leak: newly performed against 2b82889f: the negated status sentence is released beside a denial or doubt the guard (cues.UNREAD_SERVICE_DOUBT, a word list) does not recognise; 2b82889f held it only through the misreading this repair removes, and reads the document performed once the negated sentence is removed (the counterfactual invariant)
reasons.pre-existing: performed at 2b82889f as well: the denial or doubt the case carries is one routing does not read (a pronoun or 'the procedure' subject, an idiom); the repair neither adds nor removes it
reasons.named-hold: held, never released: a negated status word in the sentence of a service name ('The colonoscopy was not cancelled.') is read by the clause-cue reader, which holds it with its status word's rank (safe direction; 2b82889f held, cancelled or cut it short)
reasons.more-hold: held, never released: the negated status sentence says more than that the procedure was not called off or cut short ('... and the cecum was reached'), so it is held as a doubt (safe direction)
reasons.unread-hold: held: the bare sentence is not released because today's report also states a doubt the guard recognises, though the case's truth has none (safe direction)
reasons.base-hold: held at 2b82889f as well, by a reading this repair does not change (safe direction)
